page_hint: Chapter 18 §6 Architecture Consequence, billing/telemetry pipeline bullet
quoted_clause: cost per token rising above $0.0025 (the §18.3.2 FP16 rate in per-token units; §18.8's FP16 tier is $0.003/token)
observed: The §18.3.2 FP16 rate is $2.50 per 1M tokens. Converted to per-token units this is $2.50 / 1,000,000 = $0.0000025/token, not $0.0025/token. The printed alert threshold is therefore 1,000× too high.
evidence: Recomputation from the chunk's own Table 18-1/§18.3.2: FP16 = $2.50 per 1M tokens. $2.50 / 1,000,000 = $0.0000025 per token. The clause itself says '$0.0025 ... in per-token units', which is $2,500 per 1M tokens — inconsistent with the $2.50/1M row by three orders of magnitude. The adjacent §18.8 figure ($0.003/token) is explicitly on a different, non-comparable per-token basis and cannot rescue the conversion.
root_cause: Per-1M-token to per-token unit conversion dropped three decimal places (divided by 1,000 instead of 1,000,000).
correction: Change the alert threshold to '$0.0000025/token' (or state it as '$2.50 per 1M tokens'), and keep the §18.8 $0.003/token figure explicitly separate as a different basis.
acceptance_test: Recompute $2.50/1M tokens in per-token units and confirm the printed threshold equals $0.0000025/token; grep the chapter for '$0.0025' and confirm no remaining per-token alert uses the wrong scale.

page_hint: Chapter 15 §8 End-of-Chapter Mini-Case, paragraph beginning 'Do not read the 8.75× throughput jump'
quoted_clause: Do not read the 8.75× throughput jump as a capacity-side win.
observed: The same mini-case states throughput rises from '~8.5K to 70,000 tokens/s'. 70,000 / 8,500 ≈ 8.24×, not 8.75×. The 8.75× figure corresponds to 70,000 / 8,000, not to the printed ~8.5K baseline.
evidence: Recomputation from the chunk: baseline ~8.5K tok/s; final 70,000 tok/s. 70,000 / 8,500 = 8.235. 70,000 / 8,000 = 8.75. The chapter's own §6 derives ~8.5K as 9,200 / ~1.08 s ≈ 8.5K, so the baseline is not 8.0K.
root_cause: The multiplier appears to have been computed against a rounded-down 8.0K baseline while the prose and §6 use ~8.5K.
correction: Change '8.75×' to '~8.2×' (or state the exact baseline used, e.g. '~8.2× from ~8.5K to 70,000 tok/s').
acceptance_test: Recompute 70,000 / 8,500 and confirm the printed multiplier matches the stated baseline; grep the mini-case for '8.75' and '8.5K' to ensure they are consistent.
